mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT over the last two weeks signals fewer commuting trips, which reduces incidental retail visits and pulls RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at least 5 points below their t-2w levels.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above baseline while WORKPLACES stays deeply negative, people substitute home-centered routines for discretionary shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC down within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above +2 while WORKPLACES remains below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +2 and WORKPLACES staying below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A further drop in TRANSIT below its current depressed level indicates renewed movement suppression or stronger distancing, which directly reduces access to malls and shops and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 5 points week-on-week from t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC is flat or higher over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM falls while PARKS falls at the same time, it implies broad cutbacks in out-of-home activity rather than category substitution, and RETAIL_REC will continue to weaken over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both decline week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 7 days after both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS decline week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The move into a deeper PARKS slump captures weather or seasonally unfavorable conditions that suppress leisure trips and spill over into shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should continue falling over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS remains at or below its current level yet RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior four weeks over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM from the current trough would indicate renewed errand mobility and normalize shopping routines, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises at least 5 points from t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 5 points from t-0w but RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of falling WORKPLACES and TRANSIT with only mild RESIDENTIAL growth means mobility is collapsing outside the home, and that pattern will keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain below -35 while RESIDENTIAL stays below +4
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay below -35 and RESIDENTIAL stays below +4, but RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: If the current downward slope in WORKPLACES reverses and stays above its recent trough, it signals easing constraints or adaptation that restores discretionary stops, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES increases by at least 4 points from t-0w and stays above -36 next week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES improves by at least 4 points from t-0w and remains above -36 next week, but RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days.
